You need real-number arithmetic, two-dimensional coordinates and basic matrix–vector multiplication. Matrix square roots are introduced with a diagonal example before the general positive definite case.

01 · 长度、内积与单位球01 · Length, inner product and unit ball

Lecture 2 · pp.4–8 / textbook A.1.1–A.1.3

学完应能：读懂 x 和 z 的角色，计算三种长度，并判断一个向量是否满足单位球约束。After studying: identify the roles of x and z, compute three lengths and check membership of a unit ball.

速通 · 本章使用的记号Quick · Notation used in this chapter 当前层新增Added at this level

x 和 z 都是实数列向量，n 是它们的坐标个数。z 在每次优化中固定，x 是可以选择的向量。记为 ；记为 ；是所有满足 的向量。Both x and z are real column vectors, and n is their number of coordinates. During each optimization z is fixed and x is chosen. A is written , the is written , and the contains all vectors satisfying .

了解 · 先把一个二维向量算清楚Understand · Start with a concrete two-dimensional vector 当前层新增Added at this level

把 x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ 看成平面上的一个点，或从原点指向这个点的箭头。下标 1、2 标记坐标；右上角 T 表示转置，把列向量变成行向量。固定 z=(3,−2)ᵀ 后，zᵀx 是行向量乘列向量，结果只有一个数。Think of x=(x₁,x₂)ᵀ as a point in the plane or as an arrow from the origin. Subscripts 1 and 2 label coordinates. The superscript T denotes transpose, turning a column into a row. With z=(3,−2)ᵀ fixed, zᵀx multiplies a row by a column and produces one real number.

例如 x=(1,−1)ᵀ 时，内积为 3×1+(−2)×(−1)=5。若把 x₁ 加大，第一项会增加；若把 x₂ 变得更负，第二项也会增加。没有约束时，两种做法都能让目标无限增大。为了得到一个有限的最大响应，我们接下来限制 x 的长度。For x=(1,−1)ᵀ, the inner product is 3×1+(−2)×(−1)=5. Increasing x₁ raises the first term; making x₂ more negative raises the second. Without a constraint, either action can make the objective arbitrarily large. To obtain a finite largest response, we next limit the length of x.

为什么“长度”可以有不同规则Why length can follow different rules

范数是一个长度函数。对同一向量，它可以把各坐标的绝对值加起来，也可以按勾股定理计算，还可以只看绝对值最大的坐标。二维中常用的三个规则如下。符号 ℓ 读作小写字母 ell；下标指明所选规则，∞ 表示无穷。A norm is a length function. It may add the absolute coordinate values, use the Pythagorean rule or take the largest coordinate magnitude. The three standard two-dimensional rules are given below. The symbol ℓ is the lowercase letter ell; its subscript identifies the rule, and ∞ denotes infinity.

对 x=(3,−2)ᵀ，这三个长度分别为 5、√13、3。它们都非负，并且只有 x=0 时长度为零；把 x 乘以 t，长度就乘以 |t|；把两个向量相加，所得长度不超过两个长度之和。最后一条叫三角不等式，与走直达路线不比绕路更长的直觉相同。这些性质使它们都能称为范数。For x=(3,−2)ᵀ, the three lengths are five, √13 and three. They are nonnegative and vanish only at x=0. Multiplying x by t multiplies its length by |t|. The length of a sum is at most the sum of the two lengths. This last property is the triangle inequality, expressing that a direct route is no longer than a route through an intermediate point. These properties make all three functions norms.

单位球包含边界，也包含内部The unit ball includes its boundary and interior

单位球就是“长度最多为 1”的全部选择。ℓ₁ 约束要求 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1，所以两个坐标共享一个总预算；ℓ∞ 约束要求 |x₁|≤1 且 |x₂|≤1，所以每个坐标都可以独立使用自己的预算；ℓ₂ 约束是 x₁²+x₂²≤1。三条约束在二维里分别给出菱形、正方形和圆盘。The unit ball consists of all choices with length at most one. Under ℓ₁, the constraint |x₁|+|x₂|≤1 gives the coordinates a shared budget. Under ℓ∞, each of |x₁| and |x₂| is at most one, so each coordinate has its own budget. Under ℓ₂, the constraint is x₁²+x₂²≤1. In two dimensions these give a diamond, square and disk respectively.

看图时先找坐标轴方向的顶点：三种球都包含 (1,0) 和 (0,1)。再检查 (1,1)：它的 ℓ₁ 长度为 2、ℓ₂ 长度为 √2、ℓ∞ 长度为 1，所以只有正方形允许这个点。后面同一个目标出现三个不同最大值，原因就藏在这些不同的可行选择里。First identify the axis points in the diagrams: all three balls contain (1,0) and (0,1). Then test (1,1). Its ℓ₁, ℓ₂ and ℓ∞ lengths are two, √2 and one, so only the square admits this point. The different feasible choices will explain why the same objective has three different maximum values.

02 · 为什么要定义对偶范数02 · Why define a dual norm?

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6 · printed pp.636–637 / PDF pp.650–651

学完应能：说明固定什么、选择什么、约束什么，并用支撑直线解释最后的最大值。After studying: state what is fixed, chosen and constrained, and interpret the maximum using a supporting line.

速通 · 定义Quick · Definition 当前层新增Added at this level

固定原范数和 z，让 x 遍历原范数的单位球，对所有 zᵀx 取上确界，得到 。星号 * 标记相对于当前原范数的对偶；原范数一旦改变，右侧允许的 x 也会改变。Fix a primal norm and z. Let x range over the primal unit ball and take the supremum of zᵀx. The result is the . The star is relative to the current primal norm. Changing that norm changes the allowed vectors on the right.

了解 · 把定义读成一道优化题Understand · Read the definition as an optimization problem 当前层新增Added at this level

先问一个具体问题：一个长度预算最多为 1 的向量，能对系数 z 产生多大的内积？为了回答它，我们把每个可行 x 代入 zᵀx，再比较得到的数。例如以 ℓ∞ 为长度规则、z=(3,−2)ᵀ 时，x=(0,0) 给 0，x=(1,0) 给 3，x=(1,−1) 给 5。这些只是候选值；还需要说明能否找到比 5 更大的可行值。Start with a concrete question: how large an inner product with z can a vector produce when its length budget is at most one? Evaluate zᵀx at feasible vectors and compare the numbers. With primal norm ℓ∞ and z=(3,−2)ᵀ, the choices (0,0), (1,0) and (1,−1) give zero, three and five. These are candidate values; we must still decide whether a feasible vector can do better than five.

符号 让定义也能用于“越来越接近某个数，却没有点达到它”的情形。比如只允许 0最大值maximum。The notation also handles values that approach a number without attaining it. If 0最大值maximum in this example.

有限维空间可以先理解为只有固定个数坐标的空间。集合有界表示其中的向量长度被某个固定数限制，不能无限增大；集合闭表示集合中的一串点收敛后，极限仍留在集合中。连续函数则表示点的小幅移动不会让函数值突然跳变。有限维中的极值定理说明：在非空的闭有界集合上，连续实值函数能取到最大值和最小值。A finite-dimensional space has a fixed finite number of coordinates. A bounded set has a uniform bound on the lengths of its vectors; a closed set retains the limit of any convergent sequence from the set. Continuity means that small changes in the point cannot produce sudden jumps in the function value. The finite-dimensional extreme value theorem states that a continuous real-valued function attains both a maximum and a minimum on a nonempty closed bounded set.

本章的情况更好：单位球包括边界，而且在有限维空间里是闭且有界的。线性函数 zᵀx 连续，因此最大值实际能在单位球中取到。这里 sup 可以写成 max。教材保留 sup 的定义，计算时我们仍然要找出一个真正达到上界的 x。Our situation is better: the unit ball includes its boundary and is closed and bounded in a finite-dimensional space. Since zᵀx is continuous, it attains a maximum on that ball. Thus sup can be replaced by max here. The textbook retains sup in the definition, and our calculations will explicitly construct a vector attaining the bound.

固定的 z 与得到的数，各是什么What z and the resulting number represent

定义中的 z 是一个向量，‖z‖* 是一个数。z 决定怎样给 x 的各坐标加权，‖z‖* 记录在单位长度约束下这些权重能产生的最大响应。若把 z 乘以 2，每个内积也乘以 2，最大响应因此翻倍；若 z=0，每个内积都为零，对偶范数就是零。The input z is a vector, while ‖z‖* is a number. The vector specifies weights for the coordinates of x, and the dual norm records the largest response under the unit-length constraint. Doubling z doubles every inner product and therefore doubles the largest response. If z=0, every inner product is zero and so is the dual norm.

把内积相等的点画成直线Draw the points with the same inner product

二维中，zᵀx=c 表示目标值恰好为 c 的所有点。以 z=(1,0)ᵀ 为例，方程变成 x₁=c，所以得到一条竖直直线。c 增大时，直线向右移动。在单位圆盘里，c=0 的直线穿过中心，c=1 的直线恰好接触最右端，c>1 时就找不到可行点。因此这个方向的最大内积是 1。In two dimensions, zᵀx=c is the set of points with objective value c. For z=(1,0)ᵀ it becomes x₁=c, a vertical line. Increasing c moves the line to the right. On the unit disk, c=0 passes through its center, c=1 touches its rightmost point, and c>1 admits no feasible point. The maximum inner product in this direction is therefore one.

一般非零 z 决定直线的法向方向，也就是垂直于直线的方向。增大 c 会让直线沿 z 向外平移。最后一条还能接触单位球的直线叫支撑直线，它对应的 c 就是 ‖z‖*。给定集合和方向后这样求最大内积的函数，称为 ；对偶范数就是单位球的支撑函数。A general nonzero z specifies the normal direction, perpendicular to the line. Increasing c translates the line outward along z. The last line still touching the unit ball is a supporting line, and its c value is ‖z‖*. The function that maximizes an inner product over a set in a specified direction is its . The dual norm is the support function of the unit ball.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

先选择 ℓ₂，把方向调到 0°，把直线位置从 0 调到 1，再调到 1.1。你应看到直线从圆盘中心移到最右侧，再离开圆盘。保持方向不变切到 ℓ₁ 和 ℓ∞：三个球在横轴上的最远点都是 (1,0)，所以此时对偶值都为 1。最后把方向改成 45°，再切换球形状，比较数值怎样变化。Choose ℓ₂, set the direction to 0°, then move the line position from zero to one and to 1.1. It moves from the disk’s center to its rightmost point and then outside. Keep the direction fixed and switch to ℓ₁ and ℓ∞: all three balls reach (1,0) along this axis, so all three dual values are one. Finally use 45° and compare the values as you switch shapes.

图中 z 的欧氏长度固定为 1，方向滑块只改变方向。蓝箭头表示 z，红点表示一个最大化点，灰绿色实线表示当前位置，红色虚线表示最优支撑线。“直线位置”是 c 与最优值的比：调到 1 表示到达最优值，调到 1.1 表示试图超过它 10%。图中的 z 与上一段手算用的 (3,−2) 长度不同，数值比较时要留意这个约定。In the experiment z has Euclidean length one, and the direction slider only changes its direction. The blue arrow shows z, the red point a maximizer, the gray-green solid line the current line and the red dashed line the optimal supporting line. The position slider is c divided by the optimum: one reaches it, and 1.1 attempts a value ten percent larger. This normalized z differs in length from the vector (3,−2) used in our calculation.

为什么没有在目标外面加绝对值Why the objective needs no absolute value

任何范数都满足 ‖−x‖=‖x‖，所以单位球里的 x 和 −x 总是成对出现。如果某个 x 给出负内积，就换成 −x，得到同样大小的正内积。因此最大化 zᵀx 与最大化 |zᵀx| 的结果相同。这个结论来自可行集的对称性；如果换成不对称的集合，不能直接照用。Every norm satisfies ‖−x‖=‖x‖, so x and −x occur as a pair in its unit ball. If x gives a negative inner product, −x gives a positive one of the same magnitude. Maximizing zᵀx therefore gives the same result as maximizing |zᵀx|. This uses symmetry of the feasible set and cannot automatically be transferred to an asymmetric set.

掌握 · 为什么算出的函数仍然是范数Mastery · Why the resulting function is a norm 当前层新增Added at this level

定义给出的函数也满足第 1 节的范数性质。先看非负性：x=0 总在单位球中，目标为 0，所以上确界至少为 0。若 z=0，目标处处为 0，对偶范数为 0。若 z≠0，选 x=z/‖z‖，这里分母是原范数；它原长度为 1，而且 zᵀx=zᵀz/‖z‖>0，所以只有零向量的对偶范数为零。The defined function satisfies the norm properties from Section 1. It is nonnegative because x=0 is feasible and gives zero. When z=0, every value is zero. For z≠0 choose x=z/‖z‖, using the primal norm in the denominator. Its primal length is one and zᵀx=zᵀz/‖z‖>0. Thus the dual norm vanishes only at zero.

对缩放 t≥0，目标中的 t 可以直接从上确界提出，因此 ‖tz‖*=t‖z‖*。若 t<0，先用单位球对称性得到 ‖−z‖*=‖z‖*，再提出 |t|，所以一般有 ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖*。For t≥0, the factor t can be taken outside the supremum, giving ‖tz‖*=t‖z‖*. For t<0, symmetry first gives ‖−z‖*=‖z‖*, and then the factor |t| can be taken outside. Hence ‖tz‖*=|t|‖z‖* in general.

最后检查三角不等式。对任意单位球内的 x，(z+w)ᵀx=zᵀx+wᵀx，而两项分别不超过 ‖z‖*、‖w‖*。因此每个可行 x 都有 (z+w)ᵀx≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*，再对左侧取上确界，得到 ‖z+w‖*≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*。有限性由前面有限维闭有界单位球上的最大值存在保证。For the triangle inequality, every x in the unit ball satisfies (z+w)ᵀx=zᵀx+wᵀx, with the terms bounded by ‖z‖* and ‖w‖* respectively. Taking the supremum on the left gives ‖z+w‖*≤‖z‖*+‖w‖*. Finiteness follows from the maximum-existence result on the finite-dimensional closed bounded unit ball.

03 · 把三个常用对偶算出来03 · Calculate the three standard duals

Lecture 2 · pp.14–16 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：用同一个 z 比较三种约束，说明为什么结果不同，并给出达到最大值的向量。After studying: compare three constraints for the same z, explain their different values and give attaining vectors.

速通 · 原范数与对偶的配对Quick · Primal and dual pairs 当前层新增Added at this level

原范数Primal norm对应对偶范数Associated dual normz=(3,−2) 的对偶值Dual value at z=(3,−2)
ℓ₁ℓ∞3
ℓ₂ℓ₂√13
ℓ∞ℓ₁5

表格第一列决定定义中 x 的约束，第二列决定怎样计算 z 的对偶值。称“ℓ₂ 自对偶”，是说它的对偶仍由 ℓ₂ 长度计算。The first column determines the constraint on x in the definition; the second tells us how to compute the dual value of z. Saying that ℓ₂ is self-dual means that its dual is also calculated using the ℓ₂ length.

了解 · 从 z=(3,−2) 逐个计算Understand · Work through z=(3,−2) 当前层新增Added at this level

原范数 ℓ∞：每个坐标都可使用自己的预算Primal norm ℓ∞: a separate budget for each coordinate

约束 ‖x‖∞≤1 等价于 |x₁|≤1、|x₂|≤1。为了提高 3x₁−2x₂，第一项应选 x₁=1，第二项应选 x₂=−1。这两种选择可以同时满足，所以目标达到 3+2=5。任何可行 x 都有 3x₁≤3、−2x₂≤2，故它们的和不会超过 5。我们同时找到了上界 5 和达到这个值的向量 (1,−1)ᵀ。The constraint ‖x‖∞≤1 means |x₁|≤1 and |x₂|≤1. To improve 3x₁−2x₂, choose x₁=1 for the first term and x₂=−1 for the second. Both choices are feasible at once, giving 3+2=5. Every feasible x satisfies 3x₁≤3 and −2x₂≤2, so their sum cannot exceed five. We have found both the bound and the attaining vector (1,−1)ᵀ.

原范数 ℓ₁：两个坐标共享总预算Primal norm ℓ₁: the coordinates share a total budget

现在约束变成 |x₁|+|x₂|≤1。前面的 (1,−1) 用掉预算 2，已经不可行。第一坐标每用一单位预算能产生 3 的响应，第二坐标最多产生 2；要提高总响应，就把预算全部给第一坐标，选 x=(1,0)ᵀ，得到 3。若把一半预算给每个坐标，选 x=(1/2,−1/2)ᵀ，只得到 3/2+1=2.5。Now the constraint is |x₁|+|x₂|≤1. The previous vector (1,−1) uses a budget of two and is infeasible. A unit of budget in the first coordinate gives a response of three, while the second gives at most two. Allocate the entire budget to the first coordinate: x=(1,0)ᵀ gives three. Splitting it evenly, using (1/2,−1/2)ᵀ, gives only 3/2+1=2.5.

怎样排除别的分配更好？对每个可行 x，3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3。第二步把较小的系数 2 放大为 3，从而把两种预算合并估计。这个上界刚好由 (1,0)ᵀ 达到，因此最大值为 3。How do we rule out a better allocation? Every feasible x satisfies 3x₁−2x₂≤3|x₁|+2|x₂|≤3(|x₁|+|x₂|)≤3. The second step replaces the smaller coefficient two with three, allowing a bound in terms of the combined budget. The vector (1,0)ᵀ attains this bound, so the maximum is three.

原范数 ℓ₂：沿着 z 的方向走到圆周Primal norm ℓ₂: follow z to the circle

欧氏长度满足 ：内积不超过两个欧氏长度的乘积。这里 ‖z‖₂=√(3²+(−2)²)=√13，且 ‖x‖₂≤1，所以 zᵀx≤√13。要达到上界，让 x 与 z 同向，并把 x 缩放到长度 1，即 x=(3,−2)ᵀ/√13。The bounds an inner product by the product of the Euclidean lengths. Here ‖z‖₂=√(3²+(−2)²)=√13 and ‖x‖₂≤1, giving zᵀx≤√13. To attain it, make x point in the same direction as z and rescale its length to one: x=(3,−2)ᵀ/√13.

这两次代入各回答一个问题：第一式说明选择的 x 确实在单位球里；第二式说明它达到我们算出的上界。找到一个数值很大的向量还不够，它必须满足原约束。The two substitutions answer different questions. The first verifies that the chosen vector belongs to the unit ball; the second shows that it attains our bound. A vector with a large objective value is useful only if it satisfies the original constraint.

读完三个例子，应能分清：原范数限制 x，目标是 zᵀx，最大化点 x* 是向量，对偶值 ‖z‖* 是数。证明最大值时，先找所有可行点都无法超过的上界，再找一个可行点达到它。After these examples, distinguish the constraint on x, the objective zᵀx, the vector x* that maximizes it and the number ‖z‖*. To establish a maximum, bound every feasible value and then exhibit a feasible point attaining the bound.

掌握 · 从二维例子推广到 n 维Mastery · Extend the examples to n dimensions 当前层新增Added at this level

ℓ₂ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₂

第一个不等式允许内积为负；第二个是 Cauchy–Schwarz；第三个使用单位球约束。z≠0 时选 x*=z/‖z‖₂，它长度为 1，且 zᵀx*=‖z‖₂。z=0 时所有目标值为零，选 x=0 即可，因此对所有 z 都有 ‖z‖*=‖z‖₂。The first inequality allows a negative inner product, the second is Cauchy–Schwarz and the third uses the unit-ball constraint. For z≠0 choose x*=z/‖z‖₂, which has length one and gives zᵀx*=‖z‖₂. For z=0 all objective values vanish, so choose x=0. Thus ‖z‖*=‖z‖₂ for every z.

ℓ∞ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ∞

约束 ‖x‖∞≤1 给每个 |xᵢ|≤1，因此可以逐项作估计。要取等，选 xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ)，其中 对正、负、零分别返回 1、−1、0。这样每个坐标都满足约束，并且 zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|，相加后恰好得到上界。The constraint ‖x‖∞≤1 gives |xᵢ|≤1 for every coordinate, allowing termwise bounds. To attain them, choose xᵢ*=sgn(zᵢ), where the returns one, minus one or zero for positive, negative or zero inputs. Every coordinate is feasible and satisfies zᵢxᵢ*=|zᵢ|, so their sum reaches the bound.

ℓ₁ 的一般证明General proof for ℓ₁

令 k 是某个满足 |zₖ|=maxᵢ|zᵢ| 的坐标。若 z≠0，选 x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ，其中 只在第 k 个坐标为 1。于是 x* 的 ℓ₁ 长度为 1，且 zᵀx*=|zₖ|=‖z‖∞。若几个坐标并列最大，可以任选其中一个，最大化点也可能不唯一。若 z=0，直接取 x=0。Choose a coordinate k with |zₖ|=maxᵢ|zᵢ|. For z≠0, take x*=sgn(zₖ)eₖ, where the has one only in position k. This vector has ℓ₁ length one and gives zᵀx*=|zₖ|=‖z‖∞. If several coordinates tie, any one can be used and the maximizer may not be unique. For z=0 choose x=0.

04 · 为什么能约束任意长度的内积04 · Why the bound works for any length

Lecture 2 · p.13 / textbook A.1.6

学完应能：把一个任意非零向量缩到单位球，再解释怎样乘回原长度。After studying: rescale a nonzero vector into the unit ball and explain how to recover its original length.

速通 · 通用内积界Quick · The general inner-product bound 当前层新增Added at this level

‖x‖ 是选定的原范数，‖z‖* 是它对应的对偶范数。这条不等式对任意 x,z 都成立；x 无需先满足单位球约束。The norm of x is the chosen primal norm, and the norm of z is its associated dual. This inequality holds for every x and z; x need not initially satisfy a unit-ball constraint.

了解 · 先缩短，再把长度乘回来Understand · Shorten first, then multiply the length back 当前层新增Added at this level

对偶范数的定义只直接约束单位球里的向量，但任意非零向量都可以按比例缩进去。设原长度 r=‖x‖>0，令 u=x/r。范数的齐次性给 ‖u‖=‖x‖/r=1，所以 u 属于单位球。由定义及单位球的对称性，|zᵀu|≤‖z‖*。The definition of the dual norm directly controls vectors in the unit ball, but any nonzero vector can be rescaled into it. Let its length be r=‖x‖>0 and set u=x/r. Homogeneity gives ‖u‖=‖x‖/r=1, so u belongs to the unit ball. The definition and symmetry of the ball then give |zᵀu|≤‖z‖*.

现在把 x 写回 r u。内积对缩放是线性的，因此 zᵀx=r zᵀu；取绝对值时 r>0 不会变号。把刚才的单位长度上界乘以 r，就得到任意长度的上界。若 x=0，两个内积都为零，根本无需做除法。Now write x=r u. The inner product is linear in this scaling, so zᵀx=r zᵀu. Since r>0, taking the absolute value gives |zᵀx|=r|zᵀu|. Multiplying the unit-length bound by r gives the general bound. If x=0, both inner products are zero and no division is needed.

例如原范数是 ℓ∞，取 z=(3,−2)ᵀ、x=(2,−2)ᵀ。x 的原长度为 2，z 的对偶范数为 ‖z‖₁=5，于是上界为 2×5=10。直接计算 zᵀx=3×2+(−2)×(−2)=10，恰好取等。若仍用相同 z，但 x=(2,0)ᵀ，目标只有 6，依然满足上界 10；上界不要求每个 x 都取等。For primal norm ℓ∞, take z=(3,−2)ᵀ and x=(2,−2)ᵀ. The primal length of x is two and the dual norm of z is ‖z‖₁=5, giving a bound of ten. Direct calculation gives zᵀx=3×2+(−2)×(−2)=10, attaining it. With x=(2,0)ᵀ instead, the value is six and still obeys the bound of ten. A bound need not be attained by every vector.

掌握 · 把每个条件写进证明Mastery · Keep every condition in the proof 当前层新增Added at this level

证明最后补上 x=0 的情形：左侧为 0，右侧也为 0。不要在未知 x 是否为零时直接写 x/‖x‖。上式中的 v 是上确界内部使用的临时变量，它不改变原来固定的 z，也与已经选出的 u 没有额外约束关系。Finish by treating x=0: both sides are zero. Do not write x/‖x‖ before checking that x is nonzero. The symbol v is a temporary variable inside the supremum; it does not change the fixed z and imposes no additional relation on the already selected u.

05 · 二次范数：从椭圆换到圆05 · Quadratic norms: change an ellipse into a circle

Lecture 2 · p.8, pp.13–16 / textbook A.1.3, A.1.6, A.5.2 / HW1 · 1(a)

学完应能：解释矩阵 P 如何规定长度，理解逆矩阵出现的原因，并验证取等向量。After studying: explain how P defines length, why its inverse appears and how an attaining vector is verified.

速通 · 二次范数及其对偶Quick · A quadratic norm and its dual 当前层新增Added at this level

设 P 为实对称 。它定义的 及其在标准内积下的对偶为：Let P be a real symmetric . Its and its dual under the standard inner product are:

P,* 下标表示“以 P-二次范数为原范数时的对偶”。对 z≠0，一个达到上界的向量是下式；z=0 时取 x=0，最大值为 0。The subscript P,* means the dual associated with the P-quadratic primal norm. For z≠0 an attaining vector is given below. For z=0, use x=0 and the maximum is zero.

了解 · 先用一个椭圆解释逆权重Understand · Explain inverse weights with one ellipse 当前层新增Added at this level

P 给不同方向规定不同的长度代价P assigns different length costs to different directions

先取 P=diag(4,1)。 表示主对角线是 4、1，其余元素为零的方阵。把矩阵乘法展开，xᵀPx=4x₁²+x₂²，所以沿第一轴走一单位的长度为 2，沿第二轴走一单位的长度为 1。第一方向的位移在这个长度规则里更贵。Start with P=diag(4,1). The means a square matrix with four and one on the diagonal and zero elsewhere. Expanding the multiplication gives xᵀPx=4x₁²+x₂². A unit displacement along the first axis has length two, whereas a unit displacement along the second has length one. Motion in the first direction is more costly under this length rule.

单位球的第一轴半径为 1/2：x₂=0 时，4x₁²≤1 给 |x₁|≤1/2。第二轴半径为 1：x₁=0 时，x₂²≤1 给 |x₂|≤1。因此单位球是一个横向压窄的椭圆及其内部。若目标只想增加 x₁，最多只能走到 1/2；若只想增加 x₂，则可以走到 1。这让“较大的原权重对应较小的对偶响应”有了具体含义。The first-axis radius is 1/2: with x₂=0, the inequality 4x₁²≤1 gives |x₁|≤1/2. The second-axis radius is one: with x₁=0, we get |x₂|≤1. The unit ball is therefore an ellipse compressed horizontally, including its interior. An objective depending only on increasing x₁ can reach 1/2, while one depending only on increasing x₂ can reach one. This explains concretely why a larger primal weight reduces the dual response.

换坐标后，可以使用已经会算的圆球Change coordinates to use the Euclidean ball we already know

对这个椭圆，令 u₁=2x₁、u₂=x₂。约束立刻变成 u₁²+u₂²≤1，正好是欧氏单位圆盘。反过来，x₁=u₁/2、x₂=u₂，所以原目标 z₁x₁+z₂x₂ 变成 (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂。约束变成圆的同时，第一项的目标系数也减半了。For this ellipse, set u₁=2x₁ and u₂=x₂. The constraint becomes u₁²+u₂²≤1, the Euclidean unit disk. Conversely, x₁=u₁/2 and x₂=u₂, so z₁x₁+z₂x₂ becomes (z₁/2)u₁+z₂u₂. Turning the constraint into a circle also halves the first objective coefficient.

最后一步用第 3 节已经证明的欧氏对偶结果：圆球上的最大内积等于系数向量 (z₁/2,z₂) 的欧氏长度。平方以后第一项带 1/4，这正是 P⁻¹ 的第一对角元素。一般矩阵也按同一思路换元；逆矩阵出现的原因是原坐标要从变换后的坐标反解回来。The final step uses the Euclidean dual result proved in Section 3: on the disk, the maximum is the Euclidean length of the coefficient vector (z₁/2,z₂). Squaring introduces 1/4, the first diagonal entry of P⁻¹. A general matrix follows the same change-of-variables idea. An inverse appears because the original coordinates must be recovered from the transformed ones.

把最优点也换回原坐标Transform the maximizing point back as well

再取 z=(2,1)ᵀ。变换后目标为 u₁+u₂，系数是 (1,1)，所以最大值为 √2，圆球中的最优点为 u*=(1/√2,1/√2)ᵀ。把第一坐标除以 2，得到原椭圆中的 x*=(1/(2√2),1/√2)ᵀ。代回原约束得 4×1/8+1/2=1，代回原目标得 2/(2√2)+1/√2=√2。Now take z=(2,1)ᵀ. The transformed objective is u₁+u₂ with coefficients (1,1), so the maximum is √2 and the maximizing disk point is u*=(1/√2,1/√2)ᵀ. Divide its first coordinate by two to obtain x*=(1/(2√2),1/√2)ᵀ on the original ellipse. The constraint evaluates to 4×1/8+1/2=1 and the objective to 2/(2√2)+1/√2=√2.

注意这个 x* 与 z 并不同向。第 3 节“沿 z 走”使用了圆球的形状；椭圆先要换到圆球中，再沿变换后的系数方向走。若直接取 z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)ᵀ/√5，原约束会变成 17/5>1，这个向量不可行。Notice that x* is not parallel to z. The instruction to follow z in Section 3 relied on the circular ball. For an ellipse, first change to a circle and follow the transformed coefficient vector. Directly using z/‖z‖₂=(2,1)ᵀ/√5 would make the primal constraint 17/5>1, so that vector is infeasible.

跟着图做一次Try this with the diagram

先把 p₁=p₂=1，方向选 45°：球是圆，z 和 x* 同向。接着保持 p₂=1，只把 p₁ 增大到 4。椭圆横向变窄，红色最优向量转向第二轴，两个箭头不再同向。读出图下的 x*ᵀPx*，它应始终约为 1；再比较 zᵀx* 与“对偶值”，二者应相同。Set p₁=p₂=1 and choose 45°: the ball is circular and z and x* point in the same direction. Keep p₂=1 and increase only p₁ to four. The ellipse narrows horizontally and the red maximizing vector turns toward the second axis. Check that x*ᵀPx* remains approximately one and that zᵀx* matches the reported dual value.

这个实验使用正对角权重，且 z 的欧氏长度固定为 1，所以展示的是不同方向的变化；上一段的手算例子使用 z=(2,1)，长度不同。蓝箭头是目标系数 z，红箭头是原坐标的最优点 x*，虚线是法向为 z 的支撑线。权重滑块始终大于零，因此图中 P 一直正定。The experiment uses positive diagonal weights and a z of Euclidean length one to show directional changes. The worked vector (2,1) has a different length. The blue arrow is the objective coefficient z, the red arrow is the optimizer x* in the original coordinates, and the dashed line is a supporting line with normal z. Both weights stay positive, so P remains positive definite.

掌握 · 一般正定矩阵的完整证明Mastery · Complete proof for a general positive definite matrix 当前层新增Added at this level

第 1 步：说明换元为什么存在Step 1: explain why the transformation exists

作业给定 P∈Sⁿ 且 P≻0。Sⁿ 表示 n×n 实对称矩阵的集合，P≻0 表示所有非零 x 都有 xᵀPx>0。正定条件保证 P 的特征值全为正，所以可以求逆，也存在唯一正定 P½。这里只需要用到 P½ 对称、P½P½=P、P⁻½P½=I；I 是单位矩阵。The homework assumes P∈Sⁿ and P≻0. The set Sⁿ consists of real symmetric n×n matrices, and P≻0 means xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero x. All eigenvalues are positive, ensuring invertibility and the unique positive definite P½. We use its symmetry and the identities P½P½=P and P⁻½P½=I, where I is the identity matrix.

为看懂下一句，先回忆特征值：若非零 v 满足 Pv=λv，P 作用后 v 的方向保持在同一直线上，只缩放 λ 倍，就称 λ 为特征值、v 为特征向量。实对称矩阵能够选取一组彼此正交、欧氏长度为 1 的特征向量作为坐标轴；正定性保证对应 λ 都严格大于零。Recall the meaning of an eigenvalue: if a nonzero vector v satisfies Pv=λv, the action of P leaves it on the same line and scales it by λ. We call λ an eigenvalue and v an eigenvector. A real symmetric matrix admits an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors: each has Euclidean length one, and distinct basis vectors are perpendicular. Positive definiteness makes the associated eigenvalues strictly positive.

对 diag(4,1)，P½=diag(2,1)，P⁻½=diag(1/2,1)。一般 P 的正交特征分解写成 P=QΛQᵀ，其中 QᵀQ=I，Λ 的对角元素是正特征值。取 P½=QΛ½Qᵀ 就可以得到所需平方根；这是对特征值开平方，不能对矩阵每个元素直接开平方。For diag(4,1), P½=diag(2,1) and P⁻½=diag(1/2,1). For a general P, write its orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition P=QΛQᵀ, where QᵀQ=I and Λ contains the positive eigenvalues. The matrix QΛ½Qᵀ is the required square root. This takes square roots of eigenvalues, not of individual entries.

第 2 步：同时改写约束和目标Step 2: transform both constraint and objective

令 u=P½x，则 x=P⁻½u。变换可逆，所以原椭球中的每个 x 都对应圆球中的一个 u，反过来也成立；没有丢掉或增加可行选择。利用平方根对称性，分别改写：Set u=P½x, giving x=P⁻½u. The change is invertible, so every x in the ellipsoid corresponds to exactly one u in the Euclidean ball and conversely. No feasible choices are lost or added. Symmetry of the square root gives:

因此原约束 xᵀPx≤1 等价于 ‖u‖₂≤1。目标里新的固定系数向量是 w=P⁻½z。它与 z 维数相同，但各方向的权重经过了变换。Thus xᵀPx≤1 is equivalent to ‖u‖₂≤1. The transformed objective has fixed coefficient vector w=P⁻½z. It has the same dimension as z, but its directional weights have changed.

第 3 步：为所有可行点找上界Step 3: bound every feasible value

第一次估计使用 Cauchy–Schwarz，第二次使用 ‖u‖₂≤1。最后一步使用 P⁻½ 对称，且 P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹。至此只证明每个可行目标值都不超过 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)，还需要展示这个上界可以达到。The first bound is Cauchy–Schwarz and the second uses ‖u‖₂≤1. The final equality uses symmetry of P⁻½ and P⁻½P⁻½=P⁻¹. We have shown that every feasible value is at most d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z); we must still show that this bound can be attained.

第 4 步：构造达到上界的向量Step 4: construct an attaining vector

当 z≠0 时，可逆性保证 w=P⁻½z≠0，所以 d=‖w‖₂>0。圆球中应选 u*=w/‖w‖₂=w/d，使 u* 同向且长度为 1。把它换回原坐标，得到：For z≠0, invertibility gives w=P⁻½z≠0 and hence d=‖w‖₂>0. In the Euclidean ball choose u*=w/‖w‖₂=w/d, aligned with w and of length one. Transforming back gives:

下面直接代回作业原式。因为 P⁻¹ 对称，转置后仍是 P⁻¹；矩阵乘积中的 P⁻¹P 可以消去为 I。第一项验证可行，第二项验证达到上界：Substitute this vector into the original problem. Symmetry of P⁻¹ means its transpose is unchanged, and P⁻¹P cancels to I. The first calculation checks feasibility; the second checks attainment:

第 5 步：补上 z=0，并写出结论Step 5: handle z=0 and conclude

若 z=0，所有 zᵀx 都为零，所以最大值为零，x=0 是一个可行最大化点。此时不能使用 x*=P⁻¹z/d，因为 d=0。两种情形合在一起，才得到对每个 z 都成立的对偶公式。If z=0, every inner product is zero, so the maximum is zero and x=0 is a feasible maximizer. Do not use x*=P⁻¹z/d in this case because d=0. Combining the zero and nonzero cases establishes the dual formula for every z.

回到作业 1(a) 时，请把证明写成完整论证：说明 P≻0 的作用，给出可逆换元，为所有可行 x 找上界，构造取等点并验证，最后处理零向量。仅写最终根号没有解释为什么它就是上确界。For HW1 1(a), write a complete argument: explain the role of P≻0, give the invertible transformation, bound every feasible value, construct and verify an attaining point, then handle zero. The final square root alone does not establish the supremum.

深入 · 若 P 只有半正定，哪一步会坏掉？In depth · What fails when P is only semidefinite? 当前层新增Added at this level

取 P=diag(1,0)，它是 ：xᵀPx=x₁²≥0。但非零向量 (0,1) 的“长度”为零，所以这个函数不满足范数的正定性。约束只要求 |x₁|≤1，x₂ 可以任意大，因此可行集是无限延伸的条带。Take P=diag(1,0), a , because xᵀPx=x₁²≥0. Its “length” vanishes at the nonzero vector (0,1), so it fails definiteness of a norm. The constraint only requires |x₁|≤1, with x₂ unrestricted, producing an unbounded strip.

若 z=(0,1)，目标 zᵀx=x₂ 可随着 x₂→+∞ 无限增大，上确界为 +∞。P⁻¹ 也不存在，于是前面的可逆换元和对偶范数结论都失去了前提。若 z=(1,0)，目标只看受限制的 x₁，最大值仍为 1。这两个例子说明：半正定情形要检查目标是否沿无代价方向增长，不能机械使用正定公式。For z=(0,1), the objective is x₂, which can grow without bound, giving supremum +∞. The inverse P⁻¹ also does not exist, invalidating the earlier invertible substitution. For z=(1,0), the objective only sees the constrained coordinate and its maximum is one. The semidefinite case therefore requires checking whether the objective grows in a zero-cost direction.

了解 · 不看公式也能回答的两问Understand · Two questions to answer without formulas 当前层新增Added at this level

先检查概念。问题 1：同一个 z=(3,−2)，为什么原范数换成 ℓ₁ 后最大响应由 5 变成 3？问题 2：找到了目标值为 3 的可行向量，能立刻断定最大值就是 3 吗？先用自己的话回答，再展开下面的核对。Check the concepts first. Question 2: if a feasible vector gives objective value three, may we immediately conclude that three is the maximum? Answer in your own words before opening the checks.

展开概念核对Open the conceptual check

问题 1：ℓ∞ 允许两个坐标同时使用一单位预算，ℓ₁ 只给两个坐标合计一单位预算；原来的 (1,−1) 不再可行。问题 2：还需要证明所有可行向量的目标都不超过 3。一个可行向量只能证明“最大值至少为 3”，上界才能排除更大的值。For Question 1, ℓ∞ gives each coordinate a full unit budget, whereas ℓ₁ gives both together only one unit. The previous vector (1,−1) becomes infeasible. For Question 2, we must prove that all feasible values are at most three. One feasible vector only proves that the maximum is at least three; an upper bound rules out larger values.

掌握 · 先尝试，再逐层核对Mastery · Try first, then check progressively 当前层新增Added at this level

题 A：原范数为 ℓ₁，z=(−2,5)ᵀ。求对偶范数，并给出一个可行向量实际达到它。证明应包括一个适用于所有可行 x 的不等式。Exercise A: the primal norm is ℓ₁ and z=(−2,5)ᵀ. Find the dual norm and a feasible vector attaining it. Include an inequality valid for every feasible x.

提示：先比较系数的绝对值Hint: compare coefficient magnitudes

第二坐标的系数绝对值 5 大于第一坐标的 2。先将 −2x₁+5x₂ 上界为 5(|x₁|+|x₂|)，再考虑把预算全部给第二坐标，并使乘积为正。The second coefficient magnitude five exceeds the first magnitude two. Bound −2x₁+5x₂ by 5(|x₁|+|x₂|), then allocate all the budget to the second coordinate with a positive product.

展开题 A 的完整核对Open the complete check for A

选 x*=(0,1)ᵀ，它的 ℓ₁ 长度是 1，目标为 −2×0+5×1=5。上界 5 被实际达到，所以对偶范数为 5。Choose x*=(0,1)ᵀ. Its ℓ₁ length is one and its objective is −2×0+5×1=5. The bound is attained, so the dual norm is five.

题 B：P=diag(9,4)，z=(3,4)ᵀ。计算二次范数的对偶值，找取等向量，并检查原约束与原目标。先自己写出 P⁻¹ 和 d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z)，再尝试构造 x*。Exercise B: P=diag(9,4) and z=(3,4)ᵀ. Compute the quadratic dual value, construct an attaining vector and check the original constraint and objective. First write P⁻¹ and d=√(zᵀP⁻¹z) yourself, then construct x*.

提示 1：对角矩阵如何求逆Hint 1: invert the diagonal matrix

这里 P 的非零对角元素是 9、4，因此 P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4)。把 z 左右代入，得到 zᵀP⁻¹z=3²/9+4²/4。The nonzero diagonal entries are nine and four, giving P⁻¹=diag(1/9,1/4). Substitute z on both sides to obtain zᵀP⁻¹z=3²/9+4²/4.

提示 2：先修正方向，再归一化Hint 2: adjust the direction, then normalize

先计算 P⁻¹z=(1/3,1)ᵀ，再除以 d。原约束是 9x₁²+4x₂²≤1，不能用欧氏长度代替。First compute P⁻¹z=(1/3,1)ᵀ, then divide by d. The original constraint is 9x₁²+4x₂²≤1; do not replace it with Euclidean length.

展开题 B 的完整核对Open the complete check for B

第 5 节的通用上界说明所有可行目标不超过 √5；这里的向量满足原约束，并取得 √5，因此完成了“上界＋取等”的两部分。The general bound in Section 5 says that every feasible objective is at most √5. This vector satisfies the original constraint and attains √5, completing both parts of the argument.

题 C：P≻0 且 z=0。写出上确界的值，并解释为什么不能直接使用含 d 的取等公式。Exercise C: suppose P≻0 and z=0. State the supremum and explain why the attaining formula with denominator d cannot be used directly.

展开题 C 的核对Open the check for C

上确界是 0，因为每个目标 zᵀx 都等于 0。此时 d=0，分母公式没有定义；x=0 满足约束且取得目标 0。The supremum is zero because every objective zᵀx is zero. Here d=0, so the quotient formula is undefined. The feasible vector x=0 attains the value zero.

做完后合上答案，把题 B 重新写成一份连贯的证明。每次使用不等式或换元，都写一句依据。若某一步只能照抄公式而解释不出原因，回到第 5 节对应步骤再读一次。After finishing, close the answers and rewrite B as a connected proof. Add a reason whenever you use an inequality or substitution. If you can copy a step but cannot explain it, return to the corresponding step in Section 5.

Lecture 2 · pp.15–16; Lecture 3 · pp.60–65; Lecture 5 · p.11 / textbook A.1.6, 2.6.1, 3.3.1

学完应能：理解一般 ℓp 的取等构造，并区分范数、锥和函数的三种对偶对象。After studying: understand attainment for ℓp norms and distinguish dual objects for norms, cones and functions.

本节在“深入”层展开。This section opens at In depth depth.

深入 · 一般 ℓp 范数怎样配对In depth · How general ℓp norms pair 当前层新增Added at this level

对 1Hölder 不等式Hölder inequality说明 ，所以在 ‖x‖p≤1 下，目标不会超过 ‖z‖q。For 1Hölder 不等式Hölder inequality gives , so the objective under ‖x‖p≤1 is bounded by ‖z‖q.

还要让这个上界实际取到。对 z≠0，给第 i 个坐标分配与 |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹ 成正比的大小，并用符号函数使乘积为正；分母用于把总 ℓp 长度归一化为 1。具体选择是：We still need to attain the bound. For z≠0, allocate a magnitude proportional to |zᵢ|ᑫ⁻¹ to coordinate i and use its sign to make the product positive. The denominator normalizes the total ℓp length to one:

为什么这个幂指数正确？由 q=p/(p−1) 可算出 (q−1)p=q。所以计算每个 |xᵢ*|ᵖ 后，分子变成 |zᵢ|ᑫ；相加后正好与分母相同。检查约束与目标分别得到：Why does the exponent work? The relation q=p/(p−1) implies (q−1)p=q. Raising |xᵢ*| to p therefore produces |zᵢ|ᑫ in the numerator. Summing gives the same value as the denominator. The constraint and objective checks are:

因此 ℓp 的对偶是 ℓq。z=0 时另取 x=0；端点 p=1、p=∞ 使用第 3 节的构造，它们分别对应 q=∞、q=1。含无穷指数时，上面的有限幂表达式不适合直接代入。Thus the dual of ℓp is ℓq. For z=0 choose x=0 separately. The endpoint cases p=1 and p=∞ pair with q=∞ and q=1 and use the constructions from Section 3. The finite-power formula above should not be used by directly substituting an infinite exponent.

深入 · 矩阵的“长度”也需要说明规则In depth · Matrix length also requires a specified rule 当前层新增Added at this level

把矩阵 Z、X 的对应元素相乘再相加，就得到矩阵内积 。其中 是主对角线元素之和。用这个内积，我们同样可以固定 Z，约束 X 的长度，再问最大的响应是多少。Multiplying corresponding entries of matrices Z and X and summing gives the matrix inner product . The is the sum of diagonal entries. With this inner product, we may again fix Z, constrain the length of X and ask for the largest response.

先分清三个矩阵范数。看矩阵对欧氏向量的最大放大倍数，它等于最大奇异值。把全部奇异值相加。把全部矩阵元素的平方相加，再开平方。对 Z=diag(3,2)，这三个数分别为 3、5、√13，所以它们不能混用。Distinguish three matrix norms. The measures the largest Euclidean amplification of a vector and equals the largest singular value. The adds all singular values. The takes the square root of the sum of squared entries. For Z=diag(3,2), their values are three, five and √13 respectively, so these definitions cannot be interchanged.

课件中的矩阵 ‖X‖₂ 指谱范数。它在迹内积下的对偶是核范数。先看 Z=diag(3,2)：在 ‖X‖₂≤1 下选 X=I，迹内积为 3+2=5，而 X=I 的谱范数恰好是 1。这已经展示了对偶值至少为 5；一般证明还要说明没有更大的值。In the slide, matrix ‖X‖₂ denotes the spectral norm. Its dual under the trace inner product is the nuclear norm. For Z=diag(3,2), choose X=I under ‖X‖₂≤1. The inner product is 3+2=5, and I has spectral norm one. This exhibits a dual value of at least five; the general proof must also exclude larger values.

单位向量是欧氏长度为 1 的向量；两向量正交表示内积为零。奇异值可以理解为矩阵在一组特别选择的输入方向上的放大倍数：分解会同时选出对应的输出方向。它们是非负数，作用效果为零的方向对应零奇异值。A unit vector has Euclidean length one, and two vectors are orthogonal when their inner product is zero. Singular values can be understood as amplification factors along specially chosen input directions, with the decomposition also supplying the corresponding output directions. They are nonnegative, and directions mapped to zero correspond to zero singular values.

用 写成 Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ，其中 σᵢ 是正奇异值，uᵢ、vᵢ 是两组单位正交向量。薄分解只保留非零奇异值对应的列。对任何谱范数不超过 1 的 X，向量 Xvᵢ 的欧氏长度不超过 1，因此 Cauchy–Schwarz 给 |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1。Use the to write Z=Σᵢσᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ, where σᵢ are positive singular values and uᵢ and vᵢ form two orthonormal collections. A thin decomposition retains the columns for nonzero singular values. If ‖X‖₂≤1, the Euclidean length of Xvᵢ is at most one, and Cauchy–Schwarz gives |uᵢᵀXvᵢ|≤1.

取 X=UVᵀ，U、V 由上述单位向量作为列组成。它把每个 vᵢ 送到对应的 uᵢ，其他正交方向送到零，所以谱范数为 1，且每个 uᵢᵀXvᵢ=1，上界被取到。Z=0 时取 X=0 即可。Frobenius 范数则把矩阵当成元素组成的欧氏向量，因此它的对偶仍是 Frobenius 范数。Choose X=UVᵀ, with the indicated vectors as columns of U and V. It maps each vᵢ to uᵢ and every direction orthogonal to the columns of V to zero, so its spectral norm is one and each uᵢᵀXvᵢ=1. The bound is attained. For Z=0 take X=0. The Frobenius norm treats the entries as a Euclidean vector, so it is self-dual.

深入 · 双重对偶：把单位球的规则恢复回来In depth · Biduality recovers the original unit ball 当前层新增Added at this level

一个向量 z 属于对偶单位球，意思是 ‖z‖*≤1。把定义代入，就是原单位球中每个 x 都满足 zᵀx≤1。因此对偶单位球可以写成下面这个集合，称为 B 的 ：A vector z belongs to the dual unit ball when ‖z‖*≤1. Substituting the definition says that every x in the primal unit ball satisfies zᵀx≤1. The dual ball is therefore the following set, called the of B:

极集把原来的长度限制换成一组内积限制。再对这个新球做相同操作，就是取双重对偶。凸集合要求任意两点之间的整条线段都在集合内。有限维的闭凸集合 B 包含原点时，有 B°°=B。这个几何定理可由分离超平面定理证明：在 B 外的点，总能找到一个内积限制将它排除。由于范数的单位球满足这些条件，双重对偶恢复原球，也恢复原范数。The polar replaces the original length constraint with inner-product constraints. Repeating the same operation gives the bidual. In finite dimensions, a closed convex B containing the origin satisfies B°°=B. Convex means that the segment between any two points stays in the set. This geometric theorem follows from hyperplane separation: a point outside B can be excluded by one of the inner-product constraints. A norm ball meets the assumptions, so biduality recovers its ball and hence its norm.

这段用到了后续凸集课里的分离定理。本章说明结论的来源和条件，不把 B°°=B 当成无需证明的代数恒等式。先前的 ℓ₁ 与 ℓ∞ 配对就是直观例子：菱形的对偶球是正方形，正方形再取对偶又回到菱形。This explanation invokes the separation theorem from the later convex-set material. It states the theorem’s role and assumptions rather than treating B°°=B as an algebraic identity. The ℓ₁/ℓ∞ pairing gives a concrete picture: the diamond’s dual ball is the square, whose dual ball returns to the diamond.

深入 · 范数锥：把对偶范数用于作业 5In depth · Norm cones connect to Homework 5 当前层新增Added at this level

把向量 x 和一个实数 t 配成 (x,t)，要求 ‖x‖≤t，就得到范数锥 K。若原范数是 ℓ₂，这个集合叫 。t 是允许的长度；由于长度非负，可行点自动满足 t≥0。对偶锥 K* 定义为所有与 K 中每个点内积都非负的 (z,s)，这里内积是 zᵀx+st。Pair x with a real number t and impose ‖x‖≤t to obtain a norm cone K. For the ℓ₂ norm this is the . The value t is the allowed length, and feasibility automatically gives t≥0. The dual cone K* consists of all pairs (z,s) having nonnegative inner product zᵀx+st with every point in K.

若 ‖z‖*≤s，通用内积界给 zᵀx≥−‖z‖*‖x‖。再使用 ‖x‖≤t 和 t≥0，就有 zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0，因此 (z,s) 属于对偶锥。If ‖z‖*≤s, the general bound gives zᵀx≥−‖z‖*‖x‖. Using ‖x‖≤t and t≥0 then gives zᵀx+st≥−‖z‖*t+st≥0, so (z,s) belongs to the dual cone.

反过来，若 s<‖z‖*，就能在原单位球中选一个 u，使 zᵀu>s。取 (x,t)=(−u,1)，它满足 ‖x‖≤t，但内积等于 −zᵀu+s<0。因此这个 (z,s) 不在对偶锥中。两边合起来得到 K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}。Conversely, if s<‖z‖*, choose u in the primal unit ball with zᵀu>s. The pair (x,t)=(−u,1) satisfies ‖x‖≤t but has inner product −zᵀu+s<0. Thus (z,s) does not belong to the dual cone. Together the two directions give K*={(z,s):‖z‖*≤s}.

欧氏范数自对偶，所以它的范数锥与对偶锥使用同一条长度条件，也就是二阶锥自对偶。这一结论直接连接作业 5(b)。这里的 K* 是一个集合，前面的 ‖z‖* 是一个数，虽然都写星号，但定义的对象不同。Since the Euclidean norm is self-dual, its norm cone and dual cone use the same length condition: the second-order cone is self-dual. This connects to HW1 5(b). The object K* is a set, whereas ‖z‖* is a number; their stars act on different objects.

深入 · 范数的共轭：再看另一种星号In depth · The conjugate of a norm uses another star 当前层新增Added at this level

第五讲的 定义为 。这里 x 遍历函数定义域。若 f(x)=‖x‖，目标是在内积收益里扣除长度代价。根据这两者谁占优势，上确界会出现两种结果。The in Lecture 5 is defined by , with x ranging over the function’s domain. For f(x)=‖x‖, the objective subtracts a length cost from an inner-product reward. Comparing the two produces two cases.

若 ‖z‖*≤1，内积界给 zᵀx−‖x‖≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0。任何 x 都不能获得正收益，而 x=0 给收益 0，所以共轭值为 0。若 ‖z‖*>1，可以选 ‖u‖≤1 且 zᵀu>1；令 x=t u、t→+∞，收益变成 t(zᵀu−‖u‖)，括号严格为正，所以收益无界。If ‖z‖*≤1, the inner-product bound gives zᵀx−‖x‖≤(‖z‖*−1)‖x‖≤0. No x gives a positive reward, and x=0 gives zero, so the conjugate value is zero. If ‖z‖*>1, choose ‖u‖≤1 with zᵀu>1 and set x=t u as t→+∞. The reward becomes t(zᵀu−‖u‖), whose coefficient is positive, so it is unbounded.

在集合内取 0、集合外取 +∞ 的函数，凸分析中称为该集合的示性函数。此处的集合是对偶单位球。到这里可以分清三个记号：‖z‖* 给最大响应的数值，K* 给满足内积条件的集合，f*(z) 给扣除函数代价后的上确界函数。In convex analysis, a function that is zero on a set and +∞ outside it is that set’s indicator function. Here the set is the dual unit ball. We can now distinguish three objects: ‖z‖* is a maximum-response value, K* is a set satisfying inner-product constraints, and f*(z) is a function obtained by subtracting the function cost before taking a supremum.

学完应能：搜索中英术语，点击名词看双语释义。After studying: search terminology and click a term for a bilingual definition.

中英对照 · 符号也要解释Chinese–English · Explain symbols too 当前层新增Added at this level

中文Chinese英文English符号/缩写Symbol / abbreviation一句话解释Explanation讲解位置Section
norm‖x‖范数把一个向量变成一个非负数，用这个数表示它的长度。它要求：只有零向量的长度为零；向量乘以 t 后，长度乘以 |t|；两段路接起来的长度不超过各段长度之和。选用不同范数，相当于采用不同的长度规则。A norm assigns a nonnegative length to each vector. Only the zero vector has length zero; multiplying a vector by t multiplies its length by |t|; and the length of a sum is at most the sum of the lengths. Different norms use different rules for measuring length.回到讲解Go to section
unit ballB所有长度不超过 1 的向量；本章使用闭单位球。The set of vectors whose norm is at most one; the closed unit ball is used here.回到讲解Go to section
inner productzᵀx这里用标准内积：对应分量乘积之和。Here the standard inner product is the sum of componentwise products.回到讲解Go to section
supremumsupsup 是 supremum 的缩写。上确界是能够挡住所有可能数值的最小上界；它可以存在而没有任何点实际达到它。例如 x∈(0,1) 时，x 的上确界是 1，但没有最大值。The abbreviation sup stands for supremum. A supremum is the least upper bound on all possible values, and it may exist without being attained. For x∈(0,1), the supremum of x is one, but there is no maximum.回到讲解Go to section
maximummaxmax 是 maximum 的缩写。说一个数是最大值，需要找到一个可行点实际取得这个数，还需要说明其他可行点都不超过它。本章的有限维闭单位球上，线性目标可以取得最大值。The abbreviation max stands for maximum. A maximum is both attained by a feasible point and at least as large as every other feasible value. The linear objective in this chapter attains a maximum on the finite-dimensional closed unit ball.回到讲解Go to section
dual norm‖z‖*先选定一个原范数，再固定向量 z。让 x 在原范数的单位球中移动，计算每个可行 x 的 zᵀx。所有这些内积的最大值，就是 z 的对偶范数。它的数值取决于原范数使用的长度规则。Choose a primal norm and fix a vector z. Let x vary over the primal unit ball and evaluate zᵀx at every feasible x. The largest value is the dual norm of z. Its value depends on the length rule used by the primal norm.回到讲解Go to section
support functionh_B(z)给定集合 B 和方向 z，取 sup{x∈B} zᵀx。For a set B and direction z, the supremum of zᵀx over B.回到讲解Go to section
Hölder inequality1/p+1/q=1共轭指数对应的内积界：|zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q。An inner-product bound for conjugate exponents: |zᵀx|≤‖x‖p‖z‖q.回到讲解Go to section
Cauchy–Schwarz inequality|uᵀv|≤‖u‖₂‖v‖₂这个不等式给欧氏内积一个长度上界。两个非零向量同向时，uᵀv 等于长度的乘积；方向偏离时，内积会变小。本章用它先找上界，再沿正确方向构造达到上界的向量。This inequality bounds a Euclidean inner product by the product of the vector lengths. For nonzero vectors pointing in the same direction, uᵀv equals that product; changing their relative direction reduces the inner product. We use it to find a bound and then construct an attaining vector.回到讲解Go to section
positive definite matrixP≻0 / PDPD = Positive Definite，正定。这里 P 必须是实对称矩阵；对每个非零向量 x，都有 xᵀPx>0。这个条件让每一个非零方向都有正的长度代价，并保证 P 可以求逆。PD = Positive Definite（正定）. Here P is real and symmetric, and xᵀPx>0 for every nonzero vector x. Every nonzero direction therefore has a positive length cost, and P is invertible.回到讲解Go to section
positive semidefinite matrixP⪰0 / PSDPSD = Positive Semidefinite，半正定。对实对称矩阵 P，要求所有 x 满足 xᵀPx≥0；允许某个非零向量的二次型为零。因此 P 可能不可逆，√(xᵀPx) 也可能不满足范数“非零向量长度为正”的要求。PSD = Positive Semidefinite（半正定）. For a real symmetric P, xᵀPx≥0 for every x, but the quadratic form can vanish at a nonzero vector. P may be singular, and √(xᵀPx) may fail the definiteness requirement of a norm.回到讲解Go to section
quadratic norm‖x‖P由正定矩阵 P 定义的 √(xᵀPx)。The norm √(xᵀPx) defined by a positive definite matrix P.回到讲解Go to section
matrix square rootP½对正定 P，P½ 表示一个正定矩阵 S，使得 S²=P。它通常不能通过对每个矩阵元素分别开平方得到。利用正交特征分解，把正特征值逐个开平方，可以构造这个 S。For positive definite P, P½ denotes a positive definite matrix S satisfying S²=P. It is generally not obtained by taking square roots of individual matrix entries. An orthogonal eigenvalue decomposition constructs S by taking square roots of the positive eigenvalues.回到讲解Go to section
maximizerx* / argmax最大化点是一个可行向量：把它代入目标后，目标实际达到最大值。本章 x* 上的星号标记我们选出的最大化点。x* 是向量，最大值是一个数；这两种对象需要分清。A maximizer is a feasible vector at which the objective attains its maximum. The star on x* marks such a chosen vector. A maximizer is a vector, while the maximum value is a number; they are different kinds of objects.回到讲解Go to section
ellipsoidxᵀPx≤1正定二次型的单位球；在二维是椭圆及内部。The unit ball of a positive definite quadratic form; an ellipse with its interior in two dimensions.回到讲解Go to section
polar setB°B°={z: zᵀx≤1 对所有 x∈B}；对偶单位球等于原单位球的极集。B°={z: zᵀx≤1 for all x∈B}; the dual unit ball is the polar of the primal ball.回到讲解Go to section
conjugate functionf*定义为 sup_x(zᵀx−f(x))；与对偶范数的星号含义需区分。Defined as sup_x(zᵀx−f(x)); its star denotes function conjugacy.回到讲解Go to section
spectral norm‖Z‖₂矩阵的最大奇异值；等于由欧氏范数诱导的算子范数。The largest singular value of a matrix; the operator norm induced by Euclidean norms.回到讲解Go to section
nuclear norm‖Z‖nuc矩阵奇异值之和；在迹内积下是谱范数的对偶。The sum of singular values; the dual of the spectral norm under the trace inner product.回到讲解Go to section
Frobenius norm‖Z‖F所有矩阵元素平方和的平方根；在迹内积下自对偶。The square root of the sum of squared entries; self-dual under the trace inner product.回到讲解Go to section
Singular Value DecompositionSVDSVD = Singular Value Decomposition，奇异值分解；矩阵写成 UΣVᵀ。SVD = Singular Value Decomposition（奇异值分解）; a matrix is written UΣVᵀ.回到讲解Go to section
second-order coneSOCSOC = Second-Order Cone，二阶锥；{(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}。SOC = Second-Order Cone（二阶锥）; the set {(x,t):‖x‖₂≤t}.回到讲解Go to section
sign functionsgnsgn 是 sign 的惯用缩写。符号函数对正数返回 1，对负数返回 −1，对零返回 0。取 xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) 可以让乘积 zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|。The notation sgn is a conventional abbreviation of sign. The sign function returns one for a positive number, minus one for a negative number and zero at zero. Choosing xᵢ=sgn(zᵢ) makes zᵢxᵢ=|zᵢ|.回到讲解Go to section
diagonal-matrix notationdiagdiag 是 diagonal 的缩写。diag(a,b) 表示主对角线为 a、b，其他位置均为零的二维方阵。只有对角矩阵求逆时，才可以直接对这些非零对角元素取倒数。The notation diag abbreviates diagonal. The matrix diag(a,b) has a and b on its main diagonal and zero elsewhere. Taking reciprocals of nonzero diagonal entries gives the inverse specifically for a diagonal matrix.回到讲解Go to section
tracetrtr 是 trace 的缩写，表示方阵主对角线元素的和。矩阵内积 tr(ZᵀX) 等于 Z 与 X 对应元素乘积的总和，可以理解为把矩阵摊平成向量后的内积。The notation tr abbreviates trace, the sum of a square matrix’s diagonal entries. The matrix inner product tr(ZᵀX) is the sum of products of corresponding entries, just as if the two matrices had been flattened into vectors.回到讲解Go to section
standard basis vectoreₖeₖ 的第 k 个坐标为 1，其他坐标为零。它用于表示“只沿第 k 个坐标轴走一步”。例如二维 e₂=(0,1)ᵀ。The vector eₖ has one in coordinate k and zeros elsewhere. It represents a unit step along coordinate axis k. In two dimensions e₂=(0,1)ᵀ.回到讲解Go to section
